judgments.reason: The histopathological finding of 'Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos' appears literally in the vignette and supports cutaneous cryptococcosis, as encapsulated yeasts with halos are characteristic of Cryptococcus species in tissue.

The span 'Two distinct lesions measuring 2 × 2 cm each were identified over the glabella and right cheek' appears literally in the vignette and supports the cutaneous (skin) localization of cryptococcosis, directly indicating dermal involvement.
